headline: Moderna (MRNA) Stock May Be Overvalued After Cancer Trial Start
summary: Moderna stock has delivered a strong 70.9% gain over the past year, but the longer track record and current valuation checks suggest the shares are not clearly priced as a bargain right now. Over five years, Moderna shareholders have seen the stock decline 85.6%, which puts the recent rebound in a much longer and still challenging context. headline: Why Moderna (MRNA) Is Down 6.5% After Europe Clears Its First Flu-COVID Combo Vaccine
summary: In recent months, Moderna reported a very large year-on-year Q1 revenue increase that surpassed analyst expectations, secured two European approvals including the world’s first flu plus COVID combination vaccine mCOMBRIAX, and began a pivotal Phase 3 trial for its lung cancer candidate intismeran. headline: 1 Healthcare Stock to Keep an Eye On and 2 We Avoid
summary: Healthcare companies are pushing the status quo by innovating in areas like drug development and digital health. Those leading the charge have not only realized strong financial performance but also propelled the broader industry’s returns as healthcare stocks have gained 14.3% over the past six months while the S&P 500 was up 6.3%.
